n: CG Cookie Blender curriculum for schools
t: A downloadable Blender curriculum for schools with videos and rubrics.
steps: Download the curriculum and teaching guide.
Ask IT to install Blender on lab computers.
Check the lab computers for graphics power.
Note that CG Cookie says Blender on Chromebooks can be challenging.
Decide whether the class will use the paid units.
Ask the vendor about accounts and privacy before students sign up.
Teach unit 1 with the free content.
